title: geissorhiza rochensis var. spithamaea
intro: Geissorhiza rochensis var. spithamaea, commonly known as the Roch's geissorhiza or rock geissorhiza, is a plant species in the iris family, characterized by its small, yellow flowers and cormous habit. The health benefits of this plant include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Geissorhiza rochensis var. spithamaea include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory and antiviral activities, making it a subject of interest for further research. Bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as geissorin and spilanthol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
